warehouse_transfers_quantities_ck.name: warehouse_transfers_quantities_ck
warehouse_transfers_quantities_ck.value: "crm"."warehouse_transfers"."requested_quantity" > 0 AND ("crm"."warehouse_transfers"."accepted_quantity" IS NULL OR "crm"."warehouse_transfers"."accepted_quantity" >= 0) AND ("crm"."warehouse_transfers"."rejected_quantity" IS NULL OR "crm"."warehouse_transfers"."rejected_quantity" >= 0)

user_credentials_state_hash_ck.name: user_credentials_state_hash_ck
user_credentials_state_hash_ck.value: ("iam"."user_credentials"."state" = 'legacy' AND "iam"."user_credentials"."password_hash" IS NULL) OR ("iam"."user_credentials"."state" = 'argon2id' AND "iam"."user_credentials"."password_hash" LIKE '$argon2id$%')

users_identifier_ck.name: users_identifier_ck
users_identifier_ck.value: "iam"."users"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "iam"."users"."phone" IS NOT NULL

activities_product_prices_ck.name: activities_product_prices_ck
activities_product_prices_ck.value: ("crm"."activities"."product_dealer_price_snapshot" IS NULL OR "crm"."activities"."product_dealer_price_snapshot" >= 0) AND ("crm"."activities"."product_mrp_snapshot" IS NULL OR "crm"."activities"."product_mrp_snapshot" >= 0)

activities_completion_ck.name: activities_completion_ck
activities_completion_ck.value: ("crm"."activities"."status" = 'DONE' AND "crm"."activities"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("crm"."activities"."status" = 'PENDING' AND "crm"."activities"."completed_at" IS NULL)

ai_agent_actions_target_ck.name: ai_agent_actions_target_ck
ai_agent_actions_target_ck.value: ("crm"."ai_agent_actions"."target_type" = 'lead' AND "crm"."ai_agent_actions"."target_lead_id" = "crm"."ai_agent_actions"."target_id" AND "crm"."ai_agent_actions"."target_customer_id" IS NULL) OR ("crm"."ai_agent_actions"."target_type" = 'customer' AND "crm"."ai_agent_actions"."target_customer_id" = "crm"."ai_agent_actions"."target_id" AND "crm"."ai_agent_actions"."target_lead_id" IS NULL)

ai_agent_actions_tokens_ck.name: ai_agent_actions_tokens_ck
ai_agent_actions_tokens_ck.value: ("crm"."ai_agent_actions"."prompt_tokens" IS NULL OR "crm"."ai_agent_actions"."prompt_tokens" >= 0) AND ("crm"."ai_agent_actions"."completion_tokens" IS NULL OR "crm"."ai_agent_actions"."completion_tokens" >= 0) AND ("crm"."ai_agent_actions"."estimated_cost" IS NULL OR "crm"."ai_agent_actions"."estimated_cost" >= 0)

ai_agent_actions_lifecycle_ck.name: ai_agent_actions_lifecycle_ck
ai_agent_actions_lifecycle_ck.value: ("crm"."ai_agent_actions"."status" = 'PROPOSED' AND "crm"."ai_agent_actions"."reviewed_at" IS NULL AND "crm"."ai_agent_actions"."executed_at" IS NULL AND "crm"."ai_agent_actions"."failed_at" IS NULL AND "crm"."ai_agent_actions"."cancelled_at" IS NULL) OR ("crm"."ai_agent_actions"."status" IN ('APPROVED','REJECTED') AND "crm"."ai_agent_actions"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "crm"."ai_agent_actions"."executed_at" IS NULL AND "crm"."ai_agent_actions"."failed_at" IS NULL AND "crm"."ai_agent_actions"."cancelled_at" IS NULL) OR ("crm"."ai_agent_actions"."status" = 'EXECUTED' AND "crm"."ai_agent_actions"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "crm"."ai_agent_actions"."executed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "crm"."ai_agent_actions"."failed_at" IS NULL AND "crm"."ai_agent_actions"."cancelled_at" IS NULL) OR ("crm"."ai_agent_actions"."status" = 'FAILED' AND "crm"."ai_agent_actions"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "crm"."ai_agent_actions"."executed_at" IS NULL AND "crm"."ai_agent_actions"."failed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "crm"."ai_agent_actions"."cancelled_at" IS NULL) OR ("crm"."ai_agent_actions"."status" = 'CANCELLED' AND "crm"."ai_agent_actions"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL)

ai_customer_dossiers_scores_ck.name: ai_customer_dossiers_scores_ck
ai_customer_dossiers_scores_ck.value: ("crm"."ai_customer_dossiers"."win_probability" IS NULL OR "crm"."ai_customer_dossiers"."win_probability" BETWEEN 0 AND 1) AND ("crm"."ai_customer_dossiers"."churn_risk" IS NULL OR "crm"."ai_customer_dossiers"."churn_risk" BETWEEN 0 AND 1)

tasks_assignment_ck.name: tasks_assignment_ck
tasks_assignment_ck.value:
(
    ("crm"."tasks"."assigned_to_user_id" IS NULL AND "crm"."tasks"."assigned_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "crm"."tasks"."assigned_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("crm"."tasks"."assigned_to_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "crm"."tasks"."assigned_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "crm"."tasks"."assigned_at" IS NOT NULL)
  )

top_up_success_coherence_ck.name: top_up_success_coherence_ck
top_up_success_coherence_ck.value: ("billing"."top_up_orders"."status" = 'SUCCESS' AND "billing"."top_up_orders"."wallet_txn_id" IS NOT NULL AND "billing"."top_up_orders"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("billing"."top_up_orders"."status" <> 'SUCCESS' AND "billing"."top_up_orders"."wallet_txn_id" IS NULL)

usage_events_billing_coherence_ck.name: usage_events_billing_coherence_ck
usage_events_billing_coherence_ck.value: ("billing"."usage_events"."status" = 'BILLED' AND "billing"."usage_events"."billed_credits" IS NOT NULL AND "billing"."usage_events"."wallet_txn_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("billing"."usage_events"."status" <> 'BILLED' AND "billing"."usage_events"."wallet_txn_id" IS NULL)

usage_events_ref_coherence_ck.name: usage_events_ref_coherence_ck
usage_events_ref_coherence_ck.value: ("billing"."usage_events"."reference_type" IS NULL AND "billing"."usage_events"."reference_id" IS NULL) OR ("billing"."usage_events"."reference_type" IS NOT NULL AND "billing"."usage_events"."reference_id" IS NOT NULL)

wallet_txns_ref_coherence_ck.name: wallet_txns_ref_coherence_ck
wallet_txns_ref_coherence_ck.value: ("billing"."wallet_transactions"."reference_type" IS NULL AND "billing"."wallet_transactions"."reference_id" IS NULL) OR ("billing"."wallet_transactions"."reference_type" IS NOT NULL AND "billing"."wallet_transactions"."reference_id" IS NOT NULL)
